rows.en: (Today I'm going to a movie with Luca, but...)
Luca's late... What's keeping the guy?
I-I'm so sorry! I'm late!!
There you are at last, Luca.
I'm really sorry...! I overslept...
It's rare for you to oversleep, Luca.
My alarm clock stopped...

I see...
Then it can't be helped.
Anyway, let's hurry up and go.
That was a great movie.
The last scene is burned into my mind.

I was so into it I watched
all the way through the credits.
Oh, let's talk about it properly over a meal!
Yeah, let's do that.

(Today I'm going to a movie with Luca-kun,
but...)
Luca-kun's late...
You're finally here~!
It's rare for you to oversleep, Luca-kun.

I seeee...
Then it can't be helped.
Anyway, let's hurry up and go!
That was a great movie.
Yeah.
rows.notes: x11, female player in several scenes (incl. the Christmas scenes); kept as a plain agreement.

rows.en:
(Luca and I had plans to see a movie
again today.)
Hey, Luca.
You're early today.
I made sure to keep an eye on the clock.
Oh, it's almost time.
All right, let's go!

It was a long movie,
but it went by in a flash...

It was put together so you never got bored.
And the foreshadowing was all
properly set up, too.

Well then, sad as it is to part,
let's call it a day.

(Luca-kun and I had plans to see a movie
again today.)
Yo, Luca-kun.
You're early today.
Heehee! Is that so?
All right, let's gooo!
rows.notes: Japanese writes 'let's go' in kana (rettsu goo); x2, female player.

rows.en:
It was a long movie,
but it went by in a flash...
See ya~!

(School's finally out...
Maybe I'll walk a bit on the way home today.)

\p-san...!
What are you doing here?

I'm taking a walk for a change of pace...
What about you, Luca?

I was just taking a walk too,
for no particular reason.
That's kind of unusual for you.
...Is it?

I had this image of you as pretty organized.
Like, 'Everything on schedule!'
What kind of image do you have of me...?
rows.notes: x4, also Shirakawa in nml_myk_002 (player imagines she likes classical music); works for both.

rows.en: Oh, it's about time I headed back...
Okay. I'm glad we got to talk.
Same here. Well, see you.

(School's finally out...
Maybe I'll walk a bit on the way home today.)

I'm taking a walk for a change of pace...
What about you, Luca-kun?
That's kind of unusual for you.

I had this image of you as pretty organized.
Like, 'Everything on schedule!', you know?
Yeah, talking with you was fun.
(School's finally out...)
Want to take a little walk on the way home?
A walk? Sure, I'd like that.
All right, where should we go...
So it's Griffith Park, then.

If you want to watch the sunset,
this is the place.
...What a nice view.
Yeah, this sunset really perks you up.

It makes you want to give it your all
tomorrow too.
Well then, shall we head home...?
(That was another nice change of pace.)
Hey, hey, Luca-kun.
All right, where should we go~

If you want to watch the sunset,
this is the place!
Yeah, this sunset really perks you up.
(That was another nice change of pace~)
rows.notes: x4, also frd_myk_104/108 (incl. a male variant).
